tasks.title: Rich but safe markdown textarea with a live preview, rendered as beautiful structured HTML (headers, lists, bold, italic) on recipe pages...

Design quality: check empty state, loading state not needed (static render), long text overflow, and no AI slop patterns.
Write or update tests for all new and changed behavior
